items.question: సంగ్రహణ (précis) రాసేటప్పుడు దాని పొడవు మూల గద్యంలో ఎంత ఉండాలి? (When writing a précis, how long should it be compared to the original passage?)
items.explanation:
సంగ్రహణ మూల గద్యంలో సుమారు **మూడో వంతు (1/3)** ఉండాలి (అర్హత పత్రం అంశం 3, 10 మార్కులు). *(A précis should be about one-third of the original, item 3, 10 marks.)*

**Why not the others**
- సగం (1/2) — too long for a précis.
- మూల గద్యమంత — a précis must be shorter, not equal.
- పావు వంతు (1/4) — the standard is one-third, not a quarter.

**Key facts**
- Précis = a 1/3-length summary in your own words, with a title.
- Count the words of the original and target ~1/3.

*Source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) paper, item 3.*
items.source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) paper, item 3
covers: Précis format — 1/3rd summary in own words (10 marks)

items.question: మంచి అనువాదం (translation) దేన్ని కాపాడాలి? (What must a good translation preserve?)
options: మూల భావాన్ని, ధోరణిని సహజ భాషలో కాపాడాలి
items.explanation:
మంచి అనువాదం **మూల భావాన్ని, ధోరణిని లక్ష్య భాష సహజ శైలిలో** కాపాడాలి — పదానికి పదం కాదు. *(A good translation preserves the meaning and tone in natural target-language style, not word-for-word.)*

**Why not the others**
- పదానికి పదం — literal translation distorts sense.
- పదక్రమం యథాతథం — word order differs between languages.
- అక్షరాల సంఖ్య సమానం — letter counts need not match.

**Key facts**
- Fidelity of **meaning and register** matters more than surface form.
- Read the whole sentence, then render its sense naturally.

*Source: standard translation method (SSC standard); APPSC 07/2026 Telugu items 10-11.*
items.source: standard translation method (SSC standard); APPSC 07/2026 Telugu items 10-11

items.question: 'సూర్యుడు' అనే పదానికి పర్యాయపదం (synonym) కానిది ఏది? (Which is NOT a synonym of 'Suryudu' — the sun?)
items.explanation:
**చంద్రుడు (the moon)** సూర్యుడికి పర్యాయపదం కాదు; రవి, భానుడు, ఆదిత్యుడు అన్నీ సూర్యుని పర్యాయపదాలు. *(Chandrudu = moon, not a synonym of the sun; Ravi, Bhanudu, Adityudu are all synonyms of Suryudu.)*

**Why not the others**
- రవి, భానుడు, ఆదిత్యుడు — all mean 'sun'.

**Key facts**
- సూర్యుడు = రవి, భానుడు, ఆదిత్యుడు, భాస్కరుడు, దినకరుడు (sun).
- చంద్రుడు = శశి, ఇందు, రాకేందు (moon) — a different word set.

*Source: standard Telugu vocabulary (SSC standard); APPSC 07/2026 Telugu item 13.*
items.source: standard Telugu vocabulary (SSC standard); APPSC 07/2026 Telugu item 13

items.question: సంగ్రహణ (précis) రాసేటప్పుడు దేన్ని తొలగించాలి? (When writing a précis, what should you remove?)
items.explanation:
సంగ్రహణలో **ఉదాహరణలు, పునరుక్తులు, అనవసర వివరాలు** తొలగించి, ముఖ్య భావాన్ని మాత్రమే ఉంచాలి. *(In a précis, drop examples, repetition and unnecessary detail; keep only the central idea and essential points.)*

**Why not the others**
- మూల భావాన్ని — the central idea must be kept, never removed.
- అన్ని ముఖ్యాంశాలను — essential points are retained.
- శీర్షికను — a title is required, not removed.

**Key facts**
- Keep: central idea + essential supporting points.
- Drop: illustrations, repetition, quotations, side-details.

*Source: standard précis method (SSC standard).*
items.source: standard précis method (SSC standard)
covers: Précis technique — central idea, drop examples & repetition

items.question: సంగ్రహణకు శీర్షిక (title) ఎలా ఉండాలి? (What should a précis title be like?)
options: గద్య ఇతివృత్తాన్ని సూచించే క్లుప్తమైన, సముచితమైన పదం/పదబంధం
items.explanation:
శీర్షిక **గద్య ఇతివృత్తాన్ని (theme) సూచించే క్లుప్తమైన, సముచితమైన పదం/పదబంధం** గా ఉండాలి. *(The title should be a short, apt word/phrase capturing the theme.)*

**Why not the others**
- మొదటి వాక్యమే — the first sentence is not necessarily the theme.
- పేరా అంత పొడవు — a title must be short.
- అవసరం లేదు — a title is required and carries marks.

**Key facts**
- Title (శీర్షిక) = a crisp label of the passage's theme.
- Give it after writing the précis, once the theme is clear.

*Source: standard précis method (SSC standard).*
items.source: standard précis method (SSC standard)

items.question: సంగ్రహణ ఏ రూపంలో, ఎలా రాయాలి? (In what form should a précis be written?)
options: అనేక పేరాలుగా, ప్రథమ పురుషలో సొంత అభిప్రాయాలతో
ఒకే అనుసంధానిత పేరాగా, పరోక్ష (reported) రూపంలో, పద పరిమితి పాటిస్తూ
items.explanation:
సంగ్రహణను **ఒకే అనుసంధానిత పేరాగా, పరోక్ష రూపంలో, ~1/3 పద పరిమితిలో** రాయాలి; సొంత అభిప్రాయాలు జోడించకూడదు. *(Write it as one connected paragraph, in reported form, within ~1/3 word limit; add no opinions.)*

**Why not the others**
- అనేక పేరాలు + సొంత అభిప్రాయాలు — a précis is one paragraph with no opinions.
- ప్రశ్న-జవాబు రూపం — not a Q&A format.
- వాక్యాలను యథాతథంగా — copying the original is not summarising.

**Key facts**
- One connected paragraph, third person/reported, own words.
- Count words; stay near one-third.

*Source: standard précis method (SSC standard).*
items.source: standard précis method (SSC standard)

items.question: English→Telugu: 'She is reading a book.' — దీనికి సరైన తెలుగు అనువాదం ఏది? (Which is the correct Telugu translation?)
items.explanation:
'is reading' అనేది వర్తమాన నిరంతర కాలం (present continuous); తెలుగులో **'చదువుతోంది'** సరైన రూపం. *('Is reading' is present continuous; the correct Telugu is 'chaduvutōndi'.)*

**Why not the others**
- చదివింది — past tense ('read/has read'), wrong tense.
- చదువుతుంది — simple/future habitual ('reads/will read'), not continuous.
- రాస్తోంది — means 'is writing', wrong verb (book ≠ writing here).

**Key facts**
- Match the English tense to the Telugu tense form.
- Keep gender/number: 'she' → ఆమె (feminine singular).

*Source: standard translation practice (SSC standard); APPSC 07/2026 Telugu item 10.*
items.source: standard translation practice (SSC standard); APPSC 07/2026 Telugu item 10

items.question: Telugu→English: 'రైతులు పొలంలో పని చేస్తున్నారు.' — దీనికి సరైన ఇంగ్లీషు అనువాదం ఏది? (Which is the correct English translation?)
options: The farmers worked in the field.
The farmers will work in the field.
The farmer is working in the field.
The farmers are working in the field.
items.explanation:
'పని చేస్తున్నారు' = వర్తమాన నిరంతర, బహువచనం; కాబట్టి **'The farmers are working in the field.'** *('Chestunnaru' is present continuous, plural, so 'are working'.)*

**Why not the others**
- worked — past tense, wrong.
- The farmer is working — singular, but రైతులు is plural.
- will work — future, wrong tense.

**Key facts**
- Keep tense (present continuous) and number (plural — farmers).
- రైతులు = farmers (plural); రైతు = farmer (singular).

*Source: standard translation practice (SSC standard); APPSC 07/2026 Telugu item 11.*
items.source: standard translation practice (SSC standard); APPSC 07/2026 Telugu item 11

items.question: 'It is raining cats and dogs.' అనే జాతీయాన్ని (idiom) తెలుగులోకి ఎలా అనువదించాలి? (How should this idiom be translated into Telugu?)
items.explanation:
జాతీయాలను **అర్థానుసారంగా (సమానార్థ ప్రయోగంతో)** అనువదించాలి; 'raining cats and dogs' = **'కుండపోతగా వర్షం కురుస్తోంది'** (it is pouring heavily). *(Idioms are rendered by meaning/equivalent, so this = 'pouring heavily'.)*

**Why not the others**
- పిల్లులు, కుక్కలు వర్షిస్తున్నాయి — a literal, nonsensical rendering.
- ఆకాశం నుండి జంతువులు పడుతున్నాయి — literal, wrong.
- వర్షం లేదు — opposite meaning.

**Key facts**
- Never translate idioms/proverbs word-for-word; use an equivalent or the meaning.
- Fidelity is to **sense**, not to the literal image.

*Source: standard translation method (SSC standard).*
items.source: standard translation method (SSC standard)

items.question: 'గ్రామం' అనే తెలుగు పదానికి ఇంగ్లీషు అర్థం ఏది? (What is the English meaning of the Telugu word 'grāmam'?)
items.explanation:
'గ్రామం' అంటే **village** (also ఊరు). *('Gramam' means village; also 'uru'.)*

**Why not the others**
- city — నగరం / పట్టణం.
- river — నది.
- market — సంత / మార్కెట్టు / విపణి.

**Key facts**
- Word-meanings item (12) tests Eng↔Tel both ways.
- గ్రామం = village; నగరం = city; నది = river; సంత = market.

*Source: standard Telugu vocabulary (SSC standard); APPSC 07/2026 Telugu item 12.*
items.source: standard Telugu vocabulary (SSC standard); APPSC 07/2026 Telugu item 12

items.question: 'దినము' అనే పదానికి వ్యతిరేక పదం (antonym) ఏది? (What is the antonym of 'dinamu' — day?)
items.explanation:
'దినము/పగలు' (day) కు వ్యతిరేక పదం **రాత్రి (night)**. *(The antonym of day is night — 'ratri'.)*

**Why not the others**
- పగలు — a synonym of day, not its opposite.
- ఉదయం (morning) — a part of the day, not the opposite.
- వేకువ (dawn) — early morning, not the opposite.

**Key facts**
- Antonyms (వ్యతిరేక పదాలు): దినము × రాత్రి, సుఖం × దుఃఖం, న్యాయం × అన్యాయం.
- Item 13 tests synonyms and antonyms in both languages.

*Source: standard Telugu vocabulary (SSC standard); APPSC 07/2026 Telugu item 13.*
items.source: standard Telugu vocabulary (SSC standard); APPSC 07/2026 Telugu item 13

items.question: 'The boys played well.' — దీనికి కింది వాటిలో అత్యంత విశ్వసనీయమైన (accurate) అనువాదం ఏది? (Which is the most accurate translation, keeping number and tense?)
items.explanation:
'boys' = బహువచనం, 'played' = భూతకాలం; కాబట్టి **'బాలురు బాగా ఆడారు'** (plural + past). *('Boys' is plural and 'played' is past, so 'bāluru bāgā āḍāru'.)*

**Why not the others**
- బాలుడు ఆడాడు — singular ('the boy played'), number mismatch.
- బాలురు ఆడతారు — future/habitual ('will play/play'), tense mismatch.
- బాలుడు ఆడతాడు — singular + future, two mismatches.

**Key facts**
- Match **number** (బాలుడు singular / బాలురు plural) and **tense** (ఆడాడు past / ఆడతాడు future).
- Fidelity of number, tense and gender is essential for accuracy.

*Source: standard translation practice (SSC standard).*
items.source: standard translation practice (SSC standard)
covers: Number, tense & gender fidelity in translation

items.question: 'నీరు' అనే పదానికి పర్యాయపదం ఏది? (Which is a synonym of 'niru' — water?)
items.explanation:
'నీరు'కు పర్యాయపదం **జలం** (also ఉదకం, వారి, సలిలం, తోయం). *(A synonym of 'niru' (water) is 'jalam'; also udakam, vaari, salilam, toyam.)*

**Why not the others**
- అగ్ని (fire) — a different element.
- పవనం (wind/air) — a different element.
- భూమి (earth) — a different element.

**Key facts**
- నీరు = జలం, ఉదకం, వారి, సలిలం, తోయం (water).
- Learning synonym-sets helps both item 13 and comprehension.

*Source: standard Telugu vocabulary (SSC standard); APPSC 07/2026 Telugu item 13.*
items.source: standard Telugu vocabulary (SSC standard); APPSC 07/2026 Telugu item 13

items.question: సంగ్రహణలో ఎప్పటికీ చేయకూడనిది ఏది? (What must you NEVER do in a précis?)
options: సొంత అభిప్రాయాలను లేదా కొత్త సమాచారాన్ని జోడించడం
items.explanation:
సంగ్రహణలో **సొంత అభిప్రాయాలను లేదా కొత్త సమాచారాన్ని జోడించకూడదు** — ఇచ్చిన గద్యపు సారాన్ని మాత్రమే క్లుప్తీకరించాలి. *(Never add your own opinions or new information — only condense the given passage.)*

**Why not the others**
- ముఖ్య భావాన్ని ఉంచడం — required, not forbidden.
- ఒకే పేరాగా రాయడం — correct practice.
- శీర్షిక ఇవ్వడం — required.

**Key facts**
- A précis reports the author's ideas only, condensed — no additions, no comments.
- Keep it objective and faithful to the source.

*Source: standard précis method (SSC standard).*
items.source: standard précis method (SSC standard)
covers: Précis technique — central idea, drop examples & repetition

items.question:
Consider the following statements about the précis item (item 3) of the Telugu qualifying paper:
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
statements: The précis must be written in the candidate's own words.
The précis may add the candidate's own opinion if it is relevant.
covers: Précis format — 1/3rd summary in own words (10 marks)
Précis technique — central idea, drop examples & repetition
items.explanation:
Item 3 is a 10-mark précis in your own words. Statement 3 is wrong — a précis never adds opinion or new facts.

**Why not the others**
- 1 and 3 only — includes statement 3, which is incorrect; leaves out statement 2, which is correct
- 1, 2 and 3 — includes statement 3, which is incorrect
- 2 only — leaves out statement 1, which is correct

**Key facts**
- Length = about 1/3; give a శీర్షిక.

*Source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice*
items.source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice

items.question: Which is the correct order of steps for writing a précis?
options: Read twice → underline key points → draft → trim to 1/3 and count words → give the title last
Give the title → copy the first paragraph → count words → read once
Read once → copy every sentence → add an opinion → give the title
Draft → read twice → add examples → remove the title
covers: Précis technique — central idea, drop examples & repetition
items.explanation:
Read twice, underline, draft, trim to one-third and count words, then write the title last.

**Why not the others**
- Give the title → copy the first paragraph → count words → read once — the title comes last and copying is not précis writing.
- Read once → copy every sentence → add an opinion → give the title — copying and opinions both lose marks.
- Draft → read twice → add examples → remove the title — examples are removed, not added, and the title is required.

**Key facts**
- Title is written last, once the theme is clear.

*Source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice*
items.source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice

items.question:
Consider the following statements about a précis:
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
statements: It keeps the కేంద్ర భావం (central idea) and essential points.
It is one connected paragraph in reported (third-person) form.
Its శీర్షిక (title) should be the passage's first sentence.
items.explanation:
A précis keeps the central idea and essentials, written as one connected paragraph in reported form. Statement 3 is wrong: the title is a short phrase naming the theme, not the first sentence.

**Why not the others**
- 3 only — includes statement 3, which is incorrect; leaves out statement 1 and 2, which are correct
- 2 and 3 only — includes statement 3, which is incorrect; leaves out statement 1, which is correct
- 1 only — leaves out statement 2, which is correct

**Key facts**
- Drop examples (ఉదాహరణలు) and repetition.

*Source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice*
items.source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice

items.question: While condensing a Telugu passage, which material is the FIRST to be cut?
covers: Précis technique — central idea, drop examples & repetition
items.explanation:
Examples, illustrations and repetition add length but not new ideas, so they are cut first.

**Why not the others**
- the central idea — the central idea is the heart of the précis.
- the conclusion of the argument — the conclusion is an essential point.
- the essential supporting points — essential points must stay.

**Key facts**
- Keep the కేంద్ర భావం.

*Source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice*
items.source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice

items.question:
Consider the following statements about the translation items:
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
statements: Item 10 is English→Telugu and Item 11 is Telugu→English, 10 marks each.
A good translation conveys the భావం (meaning), not a word-for-word copy.
Tense, number and gender may be changed freely if the sentence sounds better.
items.explanation:
Items 10 and 11 are 10 marks each and are judged on meaning. Statement 3 is wrong: tense, number and gender must stay faithful.

**Why not the others**
- 3 only — includes statement 3, which is incorrect; leaves out statement 1 and 2, which are correct
- 2 only — leaves out statement 1, which is correct
- 1 and 3 only — includes statement 3, which is incorrect; leaves out statement 2, which is correct

**Key facts**
- Re-read the translation alone to check sense.

*Source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice*
items.source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice

items.question: What is the final check after finishing a translation?
options: Count the letters in each word
Re-read the translation on its own to see that it makes sense and matches the original
Add a proverb to every sentence
Translate it back word for word
items.explanation:
Reading the target text alone shows whether it is natural and faithful.

**Why not the others**
- Count the letters in each word — letter counts say nothing about meaning.
- Add a proverb to every sentence — adding proverbs changes the content.
- Translate it back word for word — word-for-word back-translation hides unnatural phrasing.

**Key facts**
- Meaning + register + tense/number/gender.

*Source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice*

covers: Number, tense & gender fidelity in translation
items.explanation:

**Why not the others**

- A-4, B-2, C-3, D-1 — pairs చదువుతుంది with read (past); చదువుతుంది actually goes with reads / will read

**Key facts**
- Tense endings decide the English tense.

*Source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice*

items.question:
Consider the following statements about translating between Telugu and English:
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
statements: Telugu follows SOV word order while English follows SVO.
Telugu has no articles, so a/an/the must be added in English.
The Telugu plural ending -లు has no English equivalent and is dropped.
Telugu shows gender in the verb ending such as -డు.
covers: Word order & grammar markers — Telugu SOV vs English SVO
Number, tense & gender fidelity in translation
items.explanation:
Telugu puts the verb last (SOV) and has no articles; gender appears in verb endings like -డు / -ది. Statement 3 is wrong: -లు becomes English -s/-es.

**Why not the others**
- 1, 2 and 3 only — includes statement 3, which is incorrect; leaves out statement 4, which is correct
- 3 and 4 only — includes statement 3, which is incorrect; leaves out statement 1 and 2, which are correct
- 1, 2, 3 and 4 — includes statement 3, which is incorrect

**Key facts**
- ఒక రైతు → a farmer; పిల్లలు → children.

*Source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice*

items.question: The request "దయచేసి మీరు కూర్చోండి" is addressed to one elder (not the familiar నువ్వు form). The best English rendering is:
items.explanation:
మీరు (respectful) and నువ్వు (familiar) both become "you"; respect is carried by please/kindly.

**Why not the others**
- You all sit. — మీరు here is the respectful singular, not "you all".
- Sit, you. — drops the politeness of దయచేసి and మీరు.
- They are sitting. — wrong person and tense.

**Key facts**
- మీరు can be respectful singular.

*Source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice*
items.source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice

items.question: A Telugu passage says "సంక్రాంతి రోజు ₹500 బహుమతి ఇచ్చారు". In translation, the festival name and the amount should be:
options: replaced by "Christmas" and a dollar amount
left out because they have no English word
rounded off to make the sentence shorter
carried over exactly — names, numbers and dates are not changed
items.explanation:
Proper nouns, numbers and dates are facts; a faithful translation keeps them.

**Why not the others**
- replaced by "Christmas" and a dollar amount — substituting an unrelated festival changes the facts.
- left out because they have no English word — omitting facts is unfaithful.
- rounded off to make the sentence shorter — numbers must be exact.

**Key facts**
- Add a short gloss for a festival name if needed.

*Source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice*
items.source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice

items.question:

Select the correct answer using the codes given below:

left.text: Make hay while the sun shines
The grass is always greener on the other side
Locking the stable after the horse has bolted

items.explanation:
Proverbs are translated by their equivalent: each pair expresses the same idea with local imagery.

**Why not the others**
- A-5, B-1, C-4, D-3, E-2 — pairs The grass is always greener on the other side with చేతులు కాలాక ఆకులు పట్టుకోవడం; The grass is always greener on the other side actually goes with దూరపు కొండలు నునుపు
- A-5, B-1, C-3, D-2, E-4 — pairs Locking the stable after the horse has bolted with ఆలస్యం అమృతం విషం; Locking the stable after the horse has bolted actually goes with చేతులు కాలాక ఆకులు పట్టుకోవడం
- A-5, B-1, C-2, D-4, E-3 — pairs The grass is always greener on the other side with ఆలస్యం అమృతం విషం; The grass is always greener on the other side actually goes with దూరపు కొండలు నునుపు

**Key facts**
- Never translate a proverb word for word.

*Source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice*
items.source: APPSC Notification 07/2026 — Telugu (Qualifying) items 3, 10-13; SSC-standard Telugu vocabulary and translation practice
